subject: Kickoff: Lasagna layer-stacking for the translation tier
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the Lasagna evaluation. The bet: our translation tier runs a uniform transformer stack, but the Lasagna work shows you can do better by choosing which layer type sits at each position in the encoder and decoder — mixing Light and Dynamic convolutions with attention where each earns its keep. If the paper's quality-at-lower-cost story transfers to our language pairs, this is a straight serving-cost win for the platform.

Milestones (Feb 9 - Jun 15):
- Mar 13: fairseq-based training path standing, incl. compiling the CUDA kernels for the Light/Dynamic conv layers
- Apr 24: Lasagna configs vs our production transformer baseline on two internal language pairs
- Early June: final architecture sweep, then the adopt/drop readout on Jun 12

Santiago — staffing and the compute plan please. The June sweep is real GPU money, so let's get the reservation sorted well ahead.

Dmitri
